lines.en: Another morning at the cafe means another chance to be poisoned by an overly creative and mildly intimidating barista.
But upon entering, I realize that Rin isn’t behind the counter.
In fact, no one is behind the counter.
No one is in the cafe at all...
What exactly is going on here?
: Hey, loser. Can’t you read?
: What's going on? Where is everyone? Also, don't call me a loser.
: I'll call you whatever I want to call you, loser. And what, was the big sign on the door saying we're closed today not enough to tip you off?
: Why are you closed? It's just a random weekend.
: Also, why are you here if you're closed? And why are you wearing your casual clothes?
: Damn, Sensei. Didn't realize we were gonna be playing twenty questions today. You know you can just ask me what color my underwear is, right? You don't have to beat around the bush.
: Wait, I can?
: No. But I thought I'd be a good friend and give you some hope since I can't give you any coffee today.
: What good is hope if you're just going to take it away immediately?
: I don't know, homie. Ask the Rin floatin' around in your fantasies later. She'll probs know better than I do.
: ...Homie?
: Sorry. I meant to say Sensei. I mix those two words up all the time.
: I feel like that would be mildly problematic if you had literally anyone else as a teacher.
: Well, I guess I'm lucky I ended up with you then, huh?
: I guess so...
: For real, though. Why are you closed?
: Repairs or something, I think. Wasn't really informed of the full details.
: All I know is that Haruka needed somebody to come in and tidy stuff up before the repair people came and I just happened to have some extra time on my hands this morning.
: Lucky for you, I've got even more spare time now since I've already finished up everything that needed to be done.
: Do you mean we're actually going to spend the morning together with you not in that funny visor?
: Woah, there! What did my visor ever do to you? You can't just talk crap on it like that.
: I blame the lack of caffeine. So, in a roundabout sort of way, it's actually your fault I said that.
: Well, I don't follow that logic at all. But if you want coffee, we can get some on the way. There are plenty of cafes between here and the urban district.
: What? We're going all the way over there?
: Hell yeah, man. I wanna walk around the city.
: I haven’t been getting out much lately and I need some exercise before my limbs fall off or stop working or something.
: Neither of those things happen due to lack of exercise but sure, I guess I’ll walk around with you.
: Neat! Well, I'm ready whenever you are.
: Oh, and the answer was black, by the way.
: The answer to- oh.
: You're welcome, homie.
Rin and I spend some time walking around the more...metropolitan section of Kumon-mi.
It's not one I venture too often, so I wind up sticking close to her as she leads us...well, wherever she's in the mood to lead us, I guess.
So far, that has equated to nothing but anime stores where she proceeded to freak out about the prices of things before getting upset and leaving.
This has happened five times now and I still do not have any coffee.
: Who shoved a stick up your butt, Mr. Crankypants?
: Excuse me?
: You've barely said anything since we left the cafe. Am I boring you, Sensei?
: Or are you just a little embarrassed to be walking around with a moderately cute girl?
: I'd rank you several levels above moderate, Rin.
: Why, that's the nicest thing anyone has ever said to me. Thank you, Sensei.
: You're welcome. Can I get coffee now?
: Oh, crap! I totally forgot!
: Why didn’t you say anything sooner?!
: I even dragged you into that one anime store that you were totally uninterested in!
: It was five.
: Five?! Why did you let me carry on for so long?!
: You need to be more open about your needs, Sensei.
: If this relationship is ever going to work, we're going to have to keep each other in check.
: Using the word relationship makes it sound like we're more than just friends, you know.
: But...we are, aren't we?
Rin pauses for a moment as her face begins to redden and her eyes get locked on mine.
I know this face. She’s about to confess her-
: Homies.
: Why do you keep saying that all of a sudden?
: What?! You said we're just friends, but we're so much more than that! Homies are like...four steps above friends.
: But I guess you probs wouldn't know that since you're such a friggin' boomer.
: Why am I being bullied today? All I wanted was coffee.
: And all I want is a cute gyaru girlfriend with fishnets and a cell phone addiction.
: I guess we can't always get what we want, though, can we?...
: Buuuuut...since I’m the greatest and coolest homie in the entire world, we can stop for coffee at the next cafe we see.
: And I just so happen to know a pretty good place right around the corner and-
: Ah-!
Rin suddenly stops walking when something catches her attention.
: Holy shit.
: Holy shit. Holy shit. Holy shit.
: What? What's wrong?
: We have been graced by the presence of an angel...
Rin lunges forward toward the angel who is none other than the Queen of Spiders herself- Kaori.
I'm surprised to see this sort of reaction out of her, though.
I get that Rin is incredibly attracted to girls, but the way she's acting toward Kaori makes it seem like-
: Oh my god! No friggin’ way! Kaori?! Is that really you?!
: H-How do you know my name?! Who are you?!
: Identify yourself!
: Uhh...what’s going on here, exactly?
: Hamburger Man! Help! I am under attack!
: ...Hamburger Man?
: It’s better to not ask.
: How are you doing, Kaori?
: Horrible! I require immediate assistance and will pay you in meat for the favors you will perform today!
: And what exactly do you need immediate assistance with? You’re not actually under attack.
: I’m...not under attack?
: Of course not. Rin's just a mildly annoying, extraordinarily horny teenager.
: It's true. I really am.
: Rin, would you mind explaining how you know Kaori? Because she...definitely does not seem like she knows you.
: Was she your waitress before or something?
: Waitress? Are you kidding? She’s like, a totally famous Instagram model!
: A...what?
: What is this ‘instant gram’ you speak of, extraordinarily aroused girl? Explain yourself.
: Sensei, remind me to show you her page later! She takes tons of super cute pictures of all kinds of stuff.
: I'm good. Not really big on social media.
: Media can talk?!
: You sure? There's a bunch of risque underwear pics on there that you'll be missing out on...
: My interest in this conversation has suddenly skyrocketed.
: What does that strange word mean? Risque?
: It means sexy.
: Sexy?! Tell me it is not so, Hamburger Man!
: Rin, how risque are these photos exactly?
: Why do you not show more concern for my well-being when I am in a clear state of crisis?!
: There aren't like, nudes or anything. Just some closeups of her tattoo and a bunch of pictures of her trying on different types of underwear.
: This can not be true! I do not even know what an instant gram is!
: The only pictures I have inserted into the digital world have been for the sake of personal documentation of my journey through this planet!
: Wait...I kinda feel like you’re being serious right now.
: You haven’t actually been...posting all of those pictures on accident, have you?
: Are we really not going to question why she’s been taking pictures in her underwear for ‘personal documentation?’
: Whose team are you on, Hamburger Man?!
: I’m on the team that wants to see those pictures.
: Those pictures are not to be seen by the prying eyes of a human male such as yourself!
: Even if you are a prime mating specimen who I am extraordinarily attracted to!
: Ah-
: What?! What is the reason for this sudden silence?!
: I am not yet familiar with human conversation! Is openly discussing mating rituals not acceptable behavior?!
: Sensei...I think Kaori wants to...mate with you...
: I...I said no such thing!
: Can I...maybe...watch?
: You may watch nothing! You are already aroused enough! Any more will result in spontaneous combustion!
: I don't mind if you watch, Rin. Kaori and I are ready to mate whenever.
: I will not mate with you, Hamburger Man! I have yet to even discover what the instant gram is!
: Too much remains undone! My body is simply not prepared!
: Kaori...wants you...to prepare her body...
: You should be referred to as the extraordinarily dishonest girl instead! The lies drip from your mouth like water from a leaky faucet!
: Sensei...what will you do?
Prepare Kaori’s body
: I suppose I’ll have to do what must be d-
: You will do no such thing!
Don’t do that thing
: I’m not sure if she’s ready yet, Rin...
: Maybe...I can help her get ready then?...
: Do not come near me, heathen!
: Why must so many confusing things happen today of all days?!
: Is something wrong, Kaori? Are you having a bad day?
: The worst day. The woman at the pet store would not provide me a furry companion to nurture and call my own!
: Why not? Did you not have enough money or something?
: I have many of the moneys! And yet each attempted transaction was refused!
: There is no justice in this world!
: Just find an animal outside. There are plenty of them just...wandering around.
: But they are so fast and I am so average-speed. I simply can not keep up.
: I...really don't know what else to tell you, Kaori.
: Of course you do, Hamburger Man...
: And yet you conceal your vast amounts of human knowledge from me.
: What?
: I do not trust you.
: And I will not mate with you.
: And I will now leave.
: Good day, humans.
: She’s...different from how I expected her to be.
: Yes, Rin.
: Yes she is.
Shortly after that, we obtained my normal human coffee and-
Oh, god damn it.
Now even I’m beginning to sound like Kaori.
We bought coffee and then I walked Rin back to the dorm.
The end.
Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!
